Use the higher of the attacker’s Strength TN and the target’s Parry as the TN for the attack, and ignore any stance modifiers for this attack; the Loremaster chooses the weapon used for the attack and how to spend any Success icons ( ). A successful AWE or PERSUADE roll from a Player-hero who is not enthralled (and who must spend their main action to do so) breaks the enchantment.
